children: Qin Zhen, Chairman and CEO of Linkhome Holdings Inc., reported beneficial ownership of a 20.143% stake in the company through US Innovation Foundation. He and Li Na disclosed the holding in a Schedule 13D filed on Oct. 16, 2026, after Qin Zhen donated 3,820,000 shares to the Foundation on Sep. 24, 2026. The move places voting and sale decisions for the shares under joint control of Qin Zhen and Li Na through the nonprofit.

Qin Zhen and Li Na agreed to act together with US Innovation Foundation on how to hold, vote, and potentially sell the shares. They state no current plans for major corporate actions, but they will review their position over time. As they put it, they have "agreed to act together with respect to the holding, voting, or disposition of the Shares."

The Foundation may sell some or all of the stock to meet liquidity needs and support its charitable mission, but it set no timeline or method. In the filing’s words, "The Foundation may from time to time dispose of some or all of such shares," including through open-market or private sales, subject to the law.

Qin Zhen is the Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Linkhome Holdings Inc., which operates an artificial intelligence real estate platform based in Irvine, California. He and Li Na also serve as directors of US Innovation Foundation, a California nonprofit that supports entrepreneurship among underrepresented communities and youths in AI. Zhen focuses on technology-led services and uses philanthropic vehicles to advance early-stage innovation and education.
